title: COMPX310 · Test 1
subtitle: Machine Learning
description:
Lectures 1–6 of COMPX310-26B plus the first three assignments — both are on the test. Every question cites the deck and slide, or the lab and part, it came from.

**Test format:** 50 minutes, in person, pen on paper. **No devices of any kind, including calculators.** One A4 cheat sheet, double-sided and printed allowed — the Cheat sheet page defaults to exactly that.

source.label: 7 lecture decks (219 slides) + 3 lab specs and notebooks
source.detail: Course material is based on Lindholm et al., *Machine Learning: A First Course for Scientists and Engineers* (CUP 2022), with figures and code from Géron, *Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn, Keras & TensorFlow* (O'Reilly 2019). The test announcement states that all lecture material from the first six weeks and the first three assignments are examinable.

documents.title: Lab 1 — kNN on the Wisconsin Breast Cancer data
Lab 2 — Decision trees and model selection (covtype)
Lab 3 — Feature subsets and logistic regression
